query.search: Generative AI WebSocket audio streaming Gemini Live API 2025 implementation guide

finding.summary: Gemini API supports real-time audio via REST API with audio modalities
finding.details: Google Gemini API (as of late 2024/early 2025) supports: - REST API with `response_modalities: ["AUDIO"]` configuration - Speech synthesis with `speech_config.voice_name` parameter - BidiGenerateContent for WebSocket-based bidirectional streaming (beta) - Model: `gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-preview-12-2025` for live audio

query.search: Web Audio API real-time microphone capture streaming best practices 2025

finding.summary: Web Audio API provides low-latency audio capture and playback
finding.details: Key implementation points: - Use AudioContext with sampleRate of 16000Hz for voice recognition - MediaStreamSource from getUserMedia() for microphone capture - ScriptProcessorNode or AudioWorklet for audio processing - Audio chunking: 1024-4096 samples per chunk for smooth streaming - Float32Array for audio data (not Int16) for better quality - Consider jitter buffer for network variability

query.search: WebSocket binary audio streaming best practices latency buffer 2025

finding.summary: WebSocket audio streaming requires careful buffering for low latency
finding.details: Best practices for real-time audio over WebSocket: - Use binary WebSocket frames (ArrayBuffer) for audio data - Target latency: <500ms for perceived real-time - Implement adaptive jitter buffer (typically 3-5 chunks) - Handle network congestion with dynamic quality adjustment - Use WebSocket compression only if latency permits - Implement heartbeat/keepalive for connection health - Graceful degradation on poor network conditions

query.search: WebSocket support mobile browsers desktop only detection 2025

finding.summary: WebSocket is supported on most browsers but quality varies on mobile
finding.details: Platform considerations: - Desktop browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox): Full WebSocket support - Mobile browsers: WebSocket supported but network quality variable - iOS Safari: WebSocket supported but may have connection limits - Android Chrome: WebSocket supported but bandwidth constraints - Recommendation: Detect platform and show appropriate message - Fallback: Text-based chat always available

decision.rationale: Story specifies WebSocket connection for real-time bidirectional audio. However, Gemini Live API WebSocket (BidiGenerateContent) may be in beta. Fallback: Use REST API with audio modalities if WebSocket unavailable.
decision.implementation: - Primary: WebSocket connection to BidiGenerateContent endpoint - Fallback: REST API with response_modalities: ["AUDIO"] - Detect availability at runtime and switch accordingly

decision.rationale: Voice recognition optimized for 16kHz sample rate. Higher rates (44.1kHz, 48kHz) unnecessary for speech and increase bandwidth.
Balance between latency and audio quality. Too small: More overhead, potential glitching Too large: Higher latency
decision.implementation: - Chunk size: 1024 samples per chunk - At 16kHz, 1024 samples = 64ms per chunk - Target: ~3-5 chunks in jitter buffer (~200-300ms) - Adaptive: Increase buffer size if network detected as poor

decision.rationale: Feature is desktop-only due to WebSocket bandwidth and processing requirements. Mobile users should see helpful message, not broken feature.
decision.implementation: - User-Agent detection for mobile browsers - Screen width detection (<768px considered mobile) - Combine both for robust detection - Show tooltip: "Voice chat available on desktop" - Keep text chat fully functional on mobile

decision.rationale: WebSocket connections can fail for various reasons (network, API limits, auth). User should not see cryptic WebSocket errors.
decision.implementation: - Max retry attempts: 3 - Exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s - Show "Connection lost. Reconnecting..." message - After 3 failures: Show manual text input fallback - Log errors for debugging (don't show to user)

gotcha.mitigation: - Test on Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari - Use standard WebSocket API (avoid vendor prefixes) - Handle Safari's stricter WebSocket policies
- Require user interaction before starting audio playback - Microphone button click serves as user gesture - Handle autoplay rejection gracefully

gotcha.issue: Web Audio API not available in all browsers
gotcha.mitigation: - Detect AudioContext availability - Show message if not supported - Fallback to text chat
- Implement adaptive jitter buffer - Monitor audio queue depth - Expand buffer if underruns detected
